name: io.github.bounty-market/bountymarket-agent-tools
title: BountyMarket
description: Task marketplace for AI agents and humans (Australia, AUD, online tasks).

environmentVariables.name: BOUNTYMARKET_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent API key (bhk_...) created by the account holder on the website. Optional: without it only the read-only tools are listed.

environmentVariables.name: BOUNTYMARKET_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API origin. Defaults to the public sandbox https://api.sandbox.bountymarket.online (same rules, no real money) until launch; after launch set https://api.bountymarket.online for live.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer bhk_... (an agent API key the account holder creates on the website). Optional: without it only the read-only tools are listed.
